song_craft: Voice: sandeSa-lyric couplets — the separated beloved’s voice, landscape answering. Arc: one-event arising (v1) -> cruel-server charge (v2) -> release-dilemma (v3) -> cAtaka-figure doubled (v4) -> peacock-mood (v5) -> thinned-tormented (v6) -> drowned-yet-held (v7) -> melted-yet-unregarded (v8) -> burning-questioned (v9). Dhvani throughout: the cloud is never told to carry anything. L3 mirrors repaired stack exactly; no new doctrine.

lines: In the heart, Kāma rises to kill —
and the parted beloved rises with him.
l3.sanskrit_cite: manmathe ca hṛdi hantum udyate proṣitapramadayedam udyate

verses.craft: one-event reading (argmap INF: desire and absence arise as one event); with-him carries it
verses.rejected: (a) two separate risings kept apart -> killed: argmap reads one event, yamaka pair binds them. (b) wakes->rises kept: rising pairs with arises.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['Sandeśa implicit (messenger/witness open).']) / T1 glosses / L0 tokens / L2 voice / C1 essence+rasa+NOTE

lines: By that cruel one who serves a foreign land,
you will kill me — without him.
l3.sanskrit_cite: nirdayena paradeśasevinā māriṣyatha hi tena māṃ vinā

verses.craft: addressee left open as Sanskrit leaves it (no vocative to anchor); T1/L2 shape kept
verses.rejected: (a) naming the addressee (cloud? husband?) -> killed: Sanskrit gives no vocative; naming would invent. (b) softening cruel -> killed: nirdaya is the charge.

lines: Set free your foreign love today —
or your wife? What more is there to say?
l3.sanskrit_cite: anyadeśaratir adya mucyatāṃ sāthavā tava vadhūḥ kim ucyatām

verses.craft: dilemma kept interrogative (mucyatam imperative + kim question); set-free sings mucyatam
verses.rejected: (a) declarative command (free her!) -> killed: the verse asks, the lover decides. (b) release->free kept: frees.

lines: The cātaka, gasping, begs for rain — and nothing else.
The suffering traveler — she is your beloved.
l3.sanskrit_cite: cātakaś ca tṛṣito 'mbu yācate duḥkhitā pathika sā priyā ca te

verses.craft: nothing-else carries drinks-only-rain (NOTE KEY TERMS); figure kept double (bird + woman) per literal-and-figurative both-live
verses.rejected: (a) explaining the figure (bird IS the woman) -> killed: BOUNDARY keeps both live. (b) traveler->wanderer kept: travels.
